1.explanation: Accordion.js and AccordionItem.js contain the JSX for rendering the skeleton variation of the accordion, including the <button> wrappers that are flagged by DAP. Button.js defines how a Carbon button renders (so you can see where to add an aria‐label or hidden text). SkeletonPlaceholder.js and SkeletonText.js show how the gray bars are implemented inside the button (and why no text is present). FormLabel.js demonstrates the Carbon pattern for associating labels with form controls (to guide how to attach a label or aria‐label to the accordion’s buttons). Reviewing these files will pinpoint where to introduce an accessible label to resolve the violation.
1.bug_scenario: In the “Skeleton” story for the Accordion component, each accordion‐item header is rendered as a <button> wrapping only skeleton placeholders (no text or aria‐label). Running IBM DAP against this markup reports multiple “Each form control must have associated label” violations because those buttons have no accessible label or visible text.
